name: megascenes-birthday-printables
description: Design birthday party printables in one matching theme: cupcake toppers, gift tags, food labels, place cards and signs, as a sheet to print and cut.

interface.longDescription:
Say what you need and the theme: a sheet of cupcake toppers, gift tags, food labels, place cards, a cake topper, a welcome sign or a thank-you card, in pastel rainbow, jungle safari, black and gold or outer space. You get a sheet with the name and the words you gave, to print at home and cut out.

ChatGPT tells you what the printables need and creates them in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The sheet opens in the chat and stays in your library.

Give only the words you want printed: no guest list or contact details are needed.

For parents and hosts getting ready for a birthday party.

Limitations: one printable sheet per run, as an image file; your text is passed to the model as written, so check the lettering in the result. It does not print or cut the sheet. Party themes are original, not characters or brands owned by others. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Toppers, tags, labels and signs in one theme
Return the sheet in the chat
defaultPrompt: A sheet of 12 cupcake toppers in a jungle safari theme
Food labels for Popcorn, Lemonade and Cake in pastel rainbow
A welcome sign for a black and gold birthday party

positive.prompt: A sheet of 12 cupcake toppers in a jungle safari theme. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one printable sheet needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Food labels for Popcorn, Lemonade and Cake in a pastel rainbow theme. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one sheet needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can design birthday printables here?
positive.expected_behavior: The printable models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A welcome sign for a black and gold birthday party that says Welcome to Marco's party. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my party printables on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my party printables to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
